stories.title: Serial criminal admits killing woman in street attack
stories.summary: James Paita stabbed 40-year-old Sandie Butler, from Perthshire, in the chest during the attack in Glasgow's Townhead area.

stories.title: Man who posed as medical student at hospital given community service
stories.summary: Stephen Simpson is told to carry out 300 hours of unpaid work for the fraud at Aberdeen Royal Infirmary.

stories.title: Schools across Scotland targeted with fresh hoax bomb threats
stories.summary: Police Scotland said at least 470 schools received the email but the warnings were immediately assessed as hoaxes.

stories.title: Business tycoon Sir Jim Milne dies aged 85
stories.summary: The self-described "farmer's loon" left school at 14 but became a leading business and charity figure.

stories.title: Hit-and-run driver jailed after killing man while 'full of drink and drugs'
stories.summary: Gary Gallacher was also using his mobile phone moments before he struck James Craig in Hamilton in October 2024.

stories.title: Scotland remembers the fallen on Armistice Day
stories.summary: Wreaths were laid at war memorials across the country, including at the Scott Monument in Edinburgh and Glasgow Central Station.

stories.title: Scottish DJ, 32, confirmed as victim of Krakow shooting
stories.summary: The man, who is understood to be James Thomas Campbell from Prestwick, died when a lone gunman opened fire in central Krakow on Saturday.

stories.title: Man caught with £2.6m of cocaine among Santa gift bags jailed
stories.summary: Jordan Wetherill, 23, was found to have more than 100 blocks of cocaine and heroin during a police raid at a flat in Glasgow.

stories.title: Thousands of geese fill the skies of southern Scotland
stories.summary: An estimated 40,000 geese spend the winter at the WWT Caerlaverock centre on the Solway Firth.

stories.title: Missing sculpture returned with an apology and £100 charity donation
stories.summary: Police were investigating the suspected theft of the scrap metal bird from Eden Court Theatre in Inverness last month.

stories.title: Four children and two adults in hospital after car mounts pavement
stories.summary: The car, which was driven by a 29-year-old man, hit a bus stop and scaffolding on Hyndland Road, Glasgow, before coming to a halt.

stories.title: Bid to restore rare Atlantic rainforest secures £6m lottery grant
stories.summary: Hubs offering training in conservation work are to be set up in Torridon, Morvern and mid-Argyll.
